facts: The appeals have been preferred by Dheeraj Verma (original accused no.1) and Deepak Verma (original accused no.2) so as to assail the order of conviction and sentence dated 30.12.2005 rendered in Sessions Trial no.55 of 2003 by the Sessions Judge, Chamba, as also, the decision rendered by the Himachal Pradesh High Court in Criminal Appeal No.27 of 2006.
Kamini Verma was married to Anmol Verma alias Munna on 6.2.2003.
Dheeraj Verma and Deepak Verma were tenants in the house of Arun Kumar (PW2, father of Kamini Verma).
The two accused were originally residents of Gurdaspur in the State of Punjab.
Kamini Verma reached Chamba from Pathankot on 28.7.2003 at about 05:30 hrs.
Dheeraj Verma and Deepak Verma came to the house of Arun Kumar (PW2, father of Kamini Verma) at Mohalla Sultanpur, Chamba at about 10:30 hrs.
Kamini Verma was taken to Zonal Hospital, Chamba immediately after the occurrence.
Rakesh Kumar was declared dead at the said Hospital at 12:30 hours on the date of the occurrence itself (i.e., on 28.7.2003).
Kamini Verma died at Kakkar Hospital, Amritsar on 1.8.2003 at 04:00 hrs.
The pellets, recovered from the wounds of Kamini Verma and from the dead body of Rakesh Kumar at Zonal Hospital, Chamba, were handed over to the police.
petitioner_arguments: A false case has been registered against them due to business rivalry.
holding: The statement of Kamini Verma was not found to be false or fabricated, nor was it manipulated at the hands of the prosecution to establish the guilt of the appellants. The discrepancies in recording time and overwriting were deemed too trivial to brush aside the overwhelming oral evidence produced by the prosecution.
